name: GSP+
full_name: GSP+ — EU Generalised Scheme of Preferences (Zero-Tariff Access)
pakistan_status: Pakistan is a GSP+ beneficiary; current arrangement expires December 2027.

rules.requirement: ILO Convention 138 — the minimum age for employment must equal the school-leaving age and be no less than 15 years. Age must be verifiable for every worker.
rules.recommendation: Retroactively obtain NADRA CNIC copies for all workers and add an ID hiring check.

rules.requirement: Maintain effective implementation of the 27 international conventions on human rights, labour rights, environmental protection and good governance that underpin Pakistan's duty-free EU access. Non-compliance can trigger reinstatement of standard ~12% tariffs.
rules.source_section: GSP Regulation (EU) No 978/2012 — GSP+ Annex VIII
rules.recommendation: Track ILO and environmental convention compliance at factory level to protect GSP+ tariff status ahead of the 2027 renewal.
